query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Aggregate and act on personal productivity signals across email, calendar, GitHub, LinkedIn, and SMS; additionally configure SMS receiving/sending and manage calendar access/events.

requirement_groups.purpose: receive and get inbound SMS messages

query_ground_truth.rationale: Configuring and managing SMS operations requires both sending capabilities and inbound message retrieval.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm SMS content, sender/sender ID, recipient mode (explicit numbers vs listIds/segmentIds), country/route, unicode/flash, and any scheduledAt time before sending.

[Optional (if building/refining a Brevo audience)] [Prerequisite]: Discover listIds via BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS, then page recipients via BREVO_GET_ALL_CONTACTS (limit/offset) and spot-check with BREVO_FIND_CONTACT.
[Required (if bulk/campaign)] [Step]: Create/send campaign using BREVO_CREATE_SMS_CAMPAIGN (name, sender, content, recipients, unsubscribeInstruction, optional scheduledAt in UTC ISO 8601).
[Required (if direct/transactional per-number send)] [Step]: Send SMS using MSG91_SEND_SMS (sender, route, country, sms[] with {message,to}).
[Optional (before large sends)] [Next Step]: Confirm available SMS credits/plan using BREVO_GET_ACCOUNT_INFO to prevent partial sends.
[Optional (for verification/audit)] [Next Step]: Review campaign status/history using BREVO_GET_SMS_CAMPAIGNS.
[Optional (if numbers are managed in Telnyx)] [Fallback]: Validate available phone numbers using TELNYX_LIST_PHONE_NUMBERS before using them as sender/recipients.
known_pitfalls: [BREVO_GET_ALL_CONTACTS] limit/offset pagination—missing pages can silently exclude part of the audience.
[BREVO_CREATE_SMS_CAMPAIGN] scheduledAt must be UTC ISO 8601; local-time inputs can send at the wrong hour.
[BREVO_CREATE_SMS_CAMPAIGN] Content + organisationPrefix/unsubscribeInstruction over 160 chars can split into multiple segments (higher cost).
[BREVO_CREATE_SMS_CAMPAIGN] Incorrect listIds/exclusionListIds/segmentIds can target the wrong customers or miss exclusions.
[MSG91_SEND_SMS] Error 407 can occur for blocked international sends; may require enabling IP security and/or approved templates before retrying.

BREVO_CREATE_SMS_CAMPAIGN.description: This tool allows you to create a new SMS campaign in Brevo. You can specify the campaign name, sender, content, recipients (by providing list IDs, exclusion list IDs, or segment IDs), and optionally schedule the campaign for a specific time. You can also enable Unicode characters, add an organization prefix, and include unsubscribe instructions.

sender.description: Name of the sender. The number of characters is limited to 11 for alphanumeric characters and 15 for numeric characters.

examples: Hello {FIRSTNAME}, check out our new offers!
content.description: Content of the message. The maximum characters used per SMS is 160; if used more than that, it will be counted as more than one SMS.

listIds.description: List of contact list IDs to send the campaign to.

segmentIds.description: List of segment IDs to send the campaign to.

exclusionListIds.description: List of contact list IDs to exclude from the campaign.

recipients.description: Recipients of the campaign. You can provide list IDs, exclusion list IDs, or segment IDs. Dict keys: `listIds` (array of list IDs to target), `exclusionListIds` (array of list IDs to exclude), `segmentIds` (array of segment IDs to target).

scheduledAt.description: UTC date-time on which the campaign has to run (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ). Prefer to pass your timezone in date-time format for accurate result.

unicodeEnabled.description: Format of the message. It indicates whether the content should be treated as unicode or not. Defaults to false.

organisationPrefix.description: A recognizable prefix will ensure your audience knows who you are. Recommended by U.S. carriers. This will be added as your Brand Name before the message content. Prefer verifying maximum length of 160 characters including this prefix in message content to avoid multiple sending of same sms.

unsubscribeInstruction.description: Instructions to unsubscribe from future communications. Recommended by U.S. carriers. Must include STOP keyword. This will be added as instructions after the end of message content. Prefer verifying maximum length of 160 characters including this instructions in message content to avoid multiple sending of same sms.

BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS.description: Retrieves all contact lists from your Brevo account with pagination support. Returns list IDs, names, subscriber counts, and folder associations. Use this to discover available lists or obtain list IDs needed for other operations (e.g., SMS campaigns, adding contacts to lists).

sort.description: Sort order by creation date: 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first).

limit.description: Number of contact lists to return per page.

offset.description: Index of the first contact list to return (for pagination).
